name: amr-mahrous-platform
description: منصة عمرو محروس التعليمية — Amr Mahrous Educational Platform. Developed by Aurexis.
author: Aurexis (https://aurexis.cc/)

scripts.//: --- Docker: the supported way to run this project ---
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.bootstrap:admin: docker compose --profile bootstrap run --rm -e BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME -e BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_FULLNAME -e BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PHONE bootstrap-admin
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:models && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace workers run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build && npm --workspace workers run build
scripts.lint: eslint --config eslint.config.mjs frontend/src backend/src workers/src scripts
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/prisma workers/src scripts tests docs *.json *.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src backend/src backend/prisma workers/src scripts tests docs *.json *.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:models
